basic_details.job_title: CoE-KISTI Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Centre of Excellence - Kerala Institute of Science, Technology and Innovation (CoE-KISTI), Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, has invited applications for 1 Project Associate post for 24 months at Rs. 25,000 per month + 10% HRA. The project is funded by Ignite Life Science Foundation. Applicants need a Master's degree in Microbiology with minimum 60% marks. Send a CV and cover letter by email to [email protected] on or before 24 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare your CV and a cover letter.
Make sure the email is sent on or before 24 November 2026 (24/11/2026).
Keep your phone and email available, since shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.
The notice names no email subject line and no further documents to attach.
important_instructions: Applications are accepted by email only, at [email protected]. Candidates with experience of working in a microbiology laboratory will be given preference. The salary is described as consolidated: Rs. 25,000 per month + 10% HRA. The selected candidate has to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. For enquiries, the notice prints the phone number +91 7907693387.

content_sections.heading: About CoE-KISTI
content_sections.text: The Kerala Institute of Science Technology and Innovation is described in the notice as a Centre of Excellence of the Kerala State Higher Education Council. It is located on the 6th floor, Convergence Academia Complex, Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam, Keralam - 686560. The notice is signed by Prof. (Dr.) Radhakrishnan EK, Coordinator, and is dated 10.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Microbiology (minimum 60% marks) from a recognized University. Candidates with experience of working in a microbiology laboratory will be given preference. The notice does not print an age limit. The discipline-specific eligibility is as printed in the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: A Master's degree in Microbiology (Minimum 60% marks) from a recognized University
rows.preference: Experience of working in a microbiology laboratory

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Associate post carries a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month + 10% HRA. The duration is 24 months. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CoE-KISTI Project Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and a cover letter. Email both to [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent on or before 24 November 2026 (24/11/2026). Keep your phone and email available, since shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The notice names no email subject line and no further documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The notice does not describe the shortlisting criteria, the interview date or the interview mode. The notice says only that the selected candidate must join duty immediately on receipt of the offer.
